supported_claim: Ibuprofen is listed among drugs that can increase the risk of bleeding when used with warfarin, and the label advises closely monitoring patients who receive it with warfarin.
verification_required_before_approval: Open https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=884cdbf6-0a52-4126-8e14-b0d7c9367e33 and confirm section 7.3 Drugs that Increase Bleeding Risk reads as the evidence text.
Grade the severity with the project's documented method (it is UNGRADED, so the loader rejects it).
Confirm the reviewed wording (MONITOR) and predicate INTERACTION, direction BIDIRECTIONAL.
how_to_approve: Grade the severity and recompute records_sha256 for the edited records file, then copy the three files into data/live_medical/relationships/v2/rel_live_0004/ (each approved V2 dataset has its own folder; never copy over another dataset's files), and set status to APPROVED and approval to {"approved_by": "<name>", "approved_at": "<YYYY-MM-DD>"}.
